unified_client.name: CCXT
unified_client.cost: free_open_source_library; public exchange endpoints; no API credentials for public data
unified_client.quality_rule: Keep source exchange and exact market symbol; book snapshots are not historical depth.

historical_archive.name: Binance Vision
historical_archive.integrity: SHA-256 checksum verified before conversion to Parquet
historical_archive.terms: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; personal non-commercial non-production research/backtesting only under current Vision Dataset Terms
historical_archive.limitation: Historical depth/MBO is not included as a freely downloadable universal archive; use exchange-specific live public feeds or separately entitled data only when allowed.

xauusd_spot_cfd.name: Dukascopy public quote history via dukascopy-node
xauusd_spot_cfd.limitation: Broker-specific OTC quote stream; not COMEX GC/MGC futures, MCX Gold, executed trade prints, or a consolidated global order book.

comex_gc_mgc.name: No free institutional-grade exchange depth feed configured
comex_gc_mgc.limitation: Do not substitute XAUUSD CFD quotes for COMEX futures trade/order-book evidence.

mcx_gold.name: No free licensed exchange-depth feed configured
mcx_gold.limitation: Requires an authorised source and custom adapter for genuine MCX exchange data.

spot_fx.name: Dukascopy public quote history via dukascopy-node
spot_fx.limitation: Broker-specific OTC quotes, not a consolidated global FX order book or complete interbank trade tape.

cme_fx_futures.name: Not included in the free-only source configuration
cme_fx_futures.limitation: CME currency futures are not spot FX.

equities_and_options.limitation: Do not imply that the selected free crypto/OTC quote sources provide licensed exchange depth for equities or options.

analytics.footprint: requires actual executed trade events, correct tick size, and defensible aggressor-side provenance; OTC quote ticks are not executions
analytics.cvd_delta: Binance aggTrades may derive aggressor side from exchange buyer-maker semantics; CCXT recent trades need venue-specific side validation; Dukascopy quote movement is not trade delta
analytics.dom_heatmap: requires continuous sequence-valid book snapshots and deltas; a single CCXT order-book snapshot is not a historical heatmap
analytics.l3_queue: requires order IDs and order-level add/modify/cancel/execute events; not supplied by the configured free fetchers
analytics.absorption_iceberg: probabilistic features only; public L2 cannot prove hidden order identity or intent
analytics.options_flow: requires individual option trades on the actual contract, with timestamp, price, size and aggressor semantics
analytics.gex: model-derived estimate; disclose gamma calculation, multiplier, input and dealer-position assumptions
